finalists.why: Highly elevated CK and cardiac troponin T levels are specific to this candidate.

finalists.label: Cardiomyopathy
finalists.why: Elevated CK and cardiac troponin T levels are consistent with this candidate, and it has no evidence against it.

finalists.label: Chemotherapy-induced cardiomyopathy
finalists.why: The temporal relationship between chemotherapy and the onset of symptoms, along with elevated CK and cardiac troponin T levels, supports this candidate.

frontier_selector.why: The temporal relationship between chemotherapy and the onset of symptoms, along with the absence of evidence against it, decided the final comparison in favor of Chemotherapy-induced cardiomyopathy.
